dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: It's not often that I have the chance to take a rest before the battle is truly over.

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: I keep asking myself, "Can I really afford to take a rest yet?" And if there are still monsters that have not yet been vanquished, the answer is no — I cannot stop now.

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: ...You'd like to join me in a moment of meditation? Oh, alright. Close your eyes. Now, join me in turning your gaze inward, to the deepest part of your being...
